description: This file is a benchmarking script for PyTorch autograd functional API, including functorch integration, defining models, tasks, and execution logic for performance measurement.

classes.name: ModelDef
classes.description: NamedTuple defining model properties including name, getter function, supported tasks, and unsupported tasks.

methods.name: get_task_func
methods.description: Returns a functional autograd task function based on task string.

methods.name: get_task_functorch
methods.description: Returns a functorch task function based on task string.

methods.name: get_v_for
methods.description: Generates a tensor or tuple of tensors for vector-Jacobian product or Hessian computations.

methods.name: run_once
methods.description: Executes a specified autograd task once.

methods.name: run_once_functorch
methods.description: Executes a specified functorch task once, with optional consistency check.

methods.name: run_model
methods.description: Runs a model on specified device and measures execution time for a task.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, run benchmarks on models and tasks, and output results.
